results.description:
In the remote Montana wilderness, a child has vanished—and time is running out.

When a fugitive accused of murdering his ex-wife disappears into the Montana backcountry with his nine-year-old daughter, FBI Hostage Rescue Team sniper Sebastian Black leads an intensive manhunt, battling snowstorms and brutal terrain in a race against the clock.

National Park Service ranger and search-and-rescue specialist Nora Deacon knows the mountains better than anyone. Alongside her K9 partner, Chance, she’s determined to find the missing girl. Nora is achingly familiar with what can happen when a child falls into the wrong hands.

As the search narrows, Sebastian and Nora are forced to work together in a fight for survival as much as a rescue operation. The closer they get to their target, the more dangerous the situation becomes—and the harder it is to ignore the attraction burning between them.

With a blizzard closing in, a desperate fugitive growing increasingly unstable, and a young girl’s life hanging in the balance, they’ll have to risk everything to bring her home alive—even if it means confronting secrets they’ve both worked hard to bury.

Cold Rage is Book 8 in the Cold Justice: Most Wanted series. Every book stands alone—start anywhere.

Readers can expect:
- 🖤 Slow-burn, forced-proximity romance
- 🖤 An FBI sniper hero and a haunted search-and-rescue ranger
- 🖤 A loyal K9 partner
- 🖤 A snowbound survival manhunt against the clock
- 🖤 A wounded heroine with a buried past
- 🖤 A child-in-peril race through the Montana wilderness
- 🖤 The Cold Justice team readers love

FBI: Most Wanted meets Yellowstone. For fans of Karen Rose, Kendra Elliot, and Laura Griffin.

This book contains subject matter some readers may find difficult, including references to past trauma. Full content guidance is available in the book and at toniandersonauthor.com
